title: Watch: Missouri suspect dives headfirst off bridge in wild bid to evade deputies
text:
Video captures a Missouri man sprinting across a bridge and diving headfirst into Table Rock Lake after leading Stone County deputies on a chase.
Bear caught on camera perched atop New Mexico utility pole before reportedly suffering fatal electrocution Teachers who once dated and share child arrested after classroom argument spiraled into violence: police EXCLUSIVE: Woman who stole $1.7M meant for hurricane victims gets prison time as DHS cracks down on FEMA fraudManhunt underway after masked gunman allegedly shoots NYC cab driver in face during overnight robberyICE urges North Carolina to keep illegal immigrant charged in triple-fatal hit-and-run behind barsNolan Wells independent autopsy doesn't point to foul play, former medical examiner saysBeloved artist stabbed, killed in 'random' beach town daytime attack as police arrest 19-year-old suspectTrump administration has lost or abandoned hundreds of lawsuits against anti-ICE protesters, migrants: reportTrump flexes power in Arizona primaries as Democrats dodge far-left upset and more top headlinesWoman's remains identified by DNA in Virginia, exposing second alleged murder linked to same 4 suspectsAlleged 'mime' stalker stripped to underwear, covered himself in cooking oil: officialsBear caught on camera stuck atop New Mexico utility poleTrump criticizes Biden administration over housing for illegal immigrantsA Missouri suspect's desperate attempt to escape authorities by diving headfirst off a bridge into the water was captured on dramatic police video before deputies took him into custody.
Video released by the Stone County Sheriff's Office shows Gavin Thor Lundgren, of Kimberling City, sprinting across a two-lane bridge before launching himself headfirst into the waters of Table Rock Lake after leading deputies on a chase during the early morning hours of July 18.
"This was definitely a first and luckily he survived the fall," the sheriff's office said in a statement. "He resisted arrest and deputies suffered minor injuries taking him into custody.
" VIDEO SHOWS ALLEGED CAR THIEF DANGLE UNDER BRIDGE AFTER WILD CHASE, SPARKING TENSE STANDOFF WITH POLICE Gavin Thor Lundgren is seen diving headfirst off a bridge into Table Rock Lake after allegedly leading Missouri deputies on a pursuit, according to the Stone County Sheriff's Office.with three counts of third-degree assault on a special victim, resisting arrest for a felony, resisting arrest by fleeing and careless driving. According to a probable cause statement, deputies attempted to stop Lundgren around 1:50 a.m. after spotting his 2004 Chevrolet Malibu traveling nearly 75 mph in a 45-mph zone, according to KOLR.
Instead of pulling over, authorities said Lundgren led deputies on a pursuit before abandoning his still-moving car and diving off the bridge into Table Rock Lake. Gavin Thor Lundgren was arrested after authorities said he led deputies on a pursuit before diving off a bridge into Table Rock Lake. Gavin Thor Lundgren is seen running across a bridge moments before diving into Table Rock Lake during an alleged attempt to evade Missouri deputies.
Officials said deputies suffered injuries including facial bruising, cuts to their hands, elbows and forearms, and abrasions.
